bayts.text: My Lord is Generous, Vast, and He bestows pre-eminence; and my means is a servant (Muḥammad) whom He has favoured.
My hardship and my poverty He has removed both together, through the Chosen One (Muḥammad), whose precedence is unknown to none.
O Lord, bless the Beloved, Muḥammad, his Family and the Companions, those who have been favoured,
with the purest of blessings joined with peace; and make Your good pleasure with them everlasting, O You for whose Face I labour.
Yours my breast, Yours my body, Yours my intention; Yours my exile, my homelands and my dwelling.
Yours my garment and my reed pen with its tablets; Yours the ink, my drink and my food.
Grant me the permanence of what You love and approve in my dwelling, Ṭūbā (Touba), which You send down (as a blessing).
From You is my departure and my migration, content; and towards You is my aim: full of hope, towards You I journey.
I have addressed my intimate prayer to a Vast Lord, who has led me with generosity and honour: how excellent a lavish Giver!
He is my Sovereign, He is the Bestower of benefit (An-Nāfiʿ), He is the Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), He is the Vast (Al-Wāsiʿ), He is the Beautiful (Al-Jamīl) who adorns with beauty.
Sovereign: to Him alone belong the east and the west, and likewise His are land and sea, and He brings all things to completion.
My face is turned towards Him through the Chosen One (Muḥammad) and the people of Badr, my companions on the way, those who were made perfect.
May the good pleasure of Him (Allah) whose enemies they subdued be upon them, and upon their companion who joins them as an uninvited guest.
A weak guest who, through them, hopes for hospitality from Him (Allah) who honours whom He wills and fills him with reverence.
I have turned my back on diversion and idle talk, turning to God through the Qur'an: how excellent the One who sent it down!
Through it (the Qur'an) and through service to the Effacer (Al-Māḥī), the Prophet (Muḥammad), I seek the Face of Him (Allah) from whom none who turns to Him is ever sent away,
as His servant; and He leads to me what I desire, and in Him — sublime is His majesty — I place all my trust.
I have called upon Him in intimacy, I am well pleased with Him, and I hope that my being pleasing to Him may excel.
Grant me my wishes and bless the Means (Al-Wasīla, Muḥammad), O You who bring forward whom You will and grant him pre-eminence.
